title: Actualización de la Contribución Determinada a nivel Nacional 3.0 de México
organization: Secretaría de Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales (SEMARNAT), Government of Mexico; submitted to UNFCCC
temporal_coverage: NDC 3.0 published in 2025; reports current and historical conditions and sets proposed actions through 2035.
methodology: Government NDC synthesizes national diagnostics and proposed climate measures.
limitations: Costa Chica annex is regional; proposed measures are not evaluated outcomes.

title: Panorama nacional de datos, tendencias y respuestas políticas al nexo entre migración, medio ambiente y cambio climático (MMACC) en México
temporal_coverage: Published 2025; reviews migration, disaster and climate evidence, including relocations through November 2024 and earlier cases.
methodology: IOM synthesis of scientific literature, policy, programmes, laws and documented mobility cases.
limitations: Evidence is stronger in central-southern Mexico; the report notes research gaps in the north.

title: Mexico Poverty and Equity Assessment
temporal_coverage: Published 2024; climate exposure estimates mainly use 2020 population and poverty-vulnerability estimates use data through 2022.
methodology: World Bank analysis combines census, household-survey, hazard-exposure and poverty-risk measures.
limitations: State vulnerability rates are estimates cited from a separate ENIGH-based model, not conflict measures.

title: Climate Change and Migration from Central America: Insights from Migrants in Mexico
organization: University of California, Berkeley School of Law Human Rights Clinic, in partnership with the Institute for Women in Migration (IMUMI)
temporal_coverage: Published April 2026; survey and interviews concern migrants in Mexico during July-December 2024.
methodology: Report combines a 2024 survey of 87 migrants in transit, key-informant interviews and desk research.
limitations: Small, non-representative sample; security findings principally concern migrants from four Central American countries.

title: Norma Oficial Mexicana NOM-003-SEDATU-2023: Lineamientos para el fortalecimiento del sistema territorial ante amenazas naturales y cambio climático
organization: Secretaría de Desarrollo Agrario, Territorial y Urbano (SEDATU), Government of Mexico; Diario Oficial de la Federación
geographic_coverage: regional, state, metropolitan and municipal planning scales
temporal_coverage: Published 14 February 2024; applies to preparation or updating of territorial and urban-development plans.
methodology: Official standard sets national multiscale territorial-planning guidelines.
limitations: Normative requirements; the standard does not report implementation or compliance results.
